name: NASA GPM IMERG Integrated Multi-satellitE Retrievals for GPM
description: IMERG (Integrated Multi-satellitE Retrievals for GPM) is the flagship global precipitation product produced by NASA Goddard Space Flight Center and JAXA. Fusing passive microwave retrievals from the Global Precipitation Measurement (GPM) constellation, geostationary infrared observations via motion-vector morphing, and monthly ground rain gauge analyses (GPCC), IMERG provides quasi-global (60°N–60°S and pole-to-pole in recent versions) precipitation rates at half-hourly 0.1°x0.1° (~10 km) resolution from 2000 to the present across Early, Late, and Final research-grade runs.
